en.answer:
Yes, it can be activated.

In this case, monsters used as Fusion Material from the Graveyard are banished face-up instead of being returned to the Deck, but the Fusion Monster is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.

The same applies while the effect of <<7478>> applies and monsters in the Graveyard are used as Fusion Material performing a Fusion Summon with the following card's effects.

en.question:
If the『Any cards that would be returned to the Deck from the Graveyard are removed from play instead.』effect of <<7478>> is applying, can I activate the『Fusion Summon 1 Level 8 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, except "<<17070>>", by shuffling Fusion Materials mentioned on it into the Deck, from your monsters on the field, Graveyard, and/or face-up banished cards』effect of <<17070>> if the only valid Fusion Materials are in the Graveyard?

If it can be activated, how does it resolve?
en.title: Can the effect of <<17070>> be activated to Fusion Summon while the effect of <<7478>> is applying?
